shared_elements: incised linear ornament covering the surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear shallow incised linear ornament including groups of hatched/chevron lines, which is about as generic as decorated surfaces get. A depicts a full anthropomorphic figure with head, face, arms and a prominent chest disc set within horizontal body bands, while B shows no figural or symbolic content at all, only an all-over field of interlocking herringbone-filled geometric panels.
